questions.title: Vertical vs Horizontal Scaling
questions.question: What is the difference between vertical scaling and horizontal scaling?
searchIntent: vertical scaling vs horizontal scaling difference
questions.realWorldScenario: Handling growing traffic — upgrading server hardware (vertical) vs adding more servers (horizontal).

questions.title: Stateless Services Enable Horizontal Scaling
questions.question: Why do stateless services scale horizontally better than stateful ones?
questions.realWorldScenario: Any request can go to any Spring Boot instance if state is not stored in-memory — enables adding instances freely.

questions.title: Connection Pooling
questions.question: What is database connection pooling and why is it important for scalability?
questions.realWorldScenario: Each API request reusing an existing DB connection rather than creating a new one — critical for performance.

questions.title: Common Scalability Bottlenecks
questions.question: What are common bottlenecks that prevent an application from scaling? How do you address them?
searchIntent: what are scalability bottlenecks in web apps
questions.realWorldScenario: Most common bottleneck: the database. Solutions: read replicas, caching, query optimisation.

questions.title: Read Replicas
questions.question: What is a database read replica and how does it help with scalability?
questions.realWorldScenario: High read-to-write ratio — direct reads to replicas, writes to primary.
